This code exhibits a classic "Read-Modify-Write" (RMW) race condition. The issue is caused by the concurrent use of the `c.mu`, `c.cache`, and `c.redisClient` during cache misses/misses.

The problem arises when two goroutines try to simultaneously check the cache local and then hit Redis. When one goroutine reads the cache miss, it proceeds to the `fetchFunc` to fetch the data.
